scripts.build: for f in admin/*.php admin/_inc/*.php db/*.php tests/*.php blog/*.php cron/*.php sitemap.php seo-media.php; do php -l "$f" >/dev/null || exit 1; done && echo "PHP syntax OK"
scripts.test: php tests/seo_logic_test.php && php tests/ai_logic_test.php && php tests/seo_article_logic_test.php
scripts.test:ai: php -S 127.0.0.1:8098 tests/mock_ai_server.php >/dev/null 2>&1 & M=$!; sleep 1; php tests/ai_batch_test.php; B=$?; php tests/ai_flow_test.php; F=$?; kill $M; [ $B -eq 0 ] && [ $F -eq 0 ]
